column2: At present, we know nothing in detail about this phenomenon called the Dimension Chain.\n\nSo Science City has decided to ask the Precog Clan for their help.
Dr. Kuruma and Science City are both searching for the prophet of Herai Village!?
Let's go to Herai Village too, {p}!
That would be best.\n\nHerai Village is a small village northeast of here, north of Science City. Dr. Kuruma is searching for the Precog Clan too. There's no telling what awaits you. Be very careful!
Herai Village is a small village northeast of here, north of Science City. Dr. Kuruma is searching for the Precog Clan too. There's no telling what awaits you. Be very careful!
I asked him to move Hell Villa near the Saotome Lab! And then he goes, "I'm coming too!"...
...Well, you see, {p}...
We all kept quiet the whole time to surprise you!
This quake's a big one!
Hey, looks like something else happened!
Akira-kun, could that residential area be where...?
Miki-chan's house might be there... I can't just sit here!
Akira-kun!?
We're thinking of checking out where Hasunuma used to be. Maybe I'll find Miki-chan there. ...If I don't hurry, Miki-chan's in danger. I've got that feeling!
Akira was going to go alone, so I talked him around and brought him here. There's no telling what's waiting. Better to bring friends.
I think so too, Akira-kun...
If I don't hurry, Miki-chan's in danger... I've got that feeling!
Be careful, Akira-kun...
I know. You too!
I wonder how Akira-kun and the others are doing...
Man, I'm glad everybody's safe.
Oh, Akira-kun, weren't you worried about me?
Big sis Miki's tough! No need to worry about her, right?
Hey!
Yikes!
Honestly!\n\nAkira-kun, the bath's ready.
Becoming Devilman changed you as a person. But those two haven't noticed. Or maybe the way you are now just seems more natural to them...
It's like that incident never happened... or even the Dimension Chain.
Maybe their memories were erased...
You're overthinking it, Ryo.
Worlds where even time passes at a different pace...\n\nMaybe there are countless worlds like that...
Akira-kun, the bath's ready.
Who the hell are you!?
Sukeban-kun!?\n\nIt's Banji Suke-kun from next door. Everybody calls him Sukeban-kun.
Beggin' your pardon this late at night!\n\nFamily name's Suke, given name's Banji! Folks call me Sukeban! Sorry, Miki-chan! See, there's a reason for all this...
What reason!?
Aunt Banchiyo's scolding you again, isn't she?
You won't get away, Banji!
Aaah, she's heeere!
Drop dead, Banji!
Eeeek!
They say Banji-kun's mom used to be a legendary girl gang boss! She's usually really sweet, but once she gets mad, nobody can handle her.
That Banji... isn't he a guy? Why was he wearing a skirt?
He says it's the uniform at the school he transferred to!
But that sure looks like a girls' uniform to me...
Zzz... Zzz...
Akira-kun, wanna get in with me?
...Idiot!
Phew... I'm glad Miki-chan's safe... But something's wrong. I've got a strange feeling. My blood's stirring... A fight's coming... The bell's about to ring!
O lovely moon... You'd best not watch what's about to happen. Not if you don't want to be stained with ugly blood...!
Ahahahaha...! Guides who'll send Devilman to Hell! Demon warriors who know nothing but battle! Come with the storm!
KYAAAH!
There's the bell! The fight is on!
What was that scream? I got so scared I wet myself...
Miki-chan's gone!? Was she kidnapped!?
Akira! Someone went out the front door!
Miki-chan!?
First time I've been back in a while... Let's take it easy a bit longer.
Demon! Give Miki-chan back!
Miki-chan...
It's all right. She's just unconscious.
Who the hell are you?
The name's Bokuto Masa... If you hadn't come, I'd've been eaten by that monster!
Wh-what's that huge bird!?
Akira! Damn! You, Bokuto Masa or whatever, come with me!
You bet!
Big sis Miki! Oh no, we gotta get her to her room!
I've won! The victory is mine, Devilman! I was waiting for the moment you let your guard down!
Ngh... Sirene?
So Amon's memories still remain!\n\nHow lovely that you remember me, Devilman!
Ngh, I can't transform into Devilman!?
My claws have the power to block every psychic power! I'll tear your body to shreds like scrap paper!
I'll give Akira Fudo the chance to defeat Sirene the bird-demon! Wait for me, Devilman!
There she is! Over there!
Good!
You're a bug crawling in the beautiful Earth's garbage heap! I'll give you a death fit for a bug!
Ryo! Don't tell me...!?
GYEEEEEEH!
Akira! Are you all right!?
Damn you, Sirene!\n\nYou called me, called humans, bugs crawling in a garbage heap! Now see what this bug can do!
Let's go, Ryo! Masa!
...I'm beating Sirene here and now! I can't go back yet!!
I'll tear you into a hundred pieces of meat! Come, Devilman!
Quit struggling, damn you. You've lost, Sirene.
Ngh! The wound is deep... Can I not win... I can't die like this! I want the power to defeat Devilman...!
Sirene, use my body! Merge with me!
Merge? What are you saying, Kaim! Even if we beat Devilman, we'll both die soon after! Are you all right with that, Kaim!?
I don't intend to survive...\n\nSirene, I just want you to taste the thrill of victory.
Wh-why...
Sirene... Even covered in blood, you're beautiful...
Kaim!
Devilman!\n\nSirene's obsession and Kaim's life will defeat you! I'll offer your life to Kaim!
Ngh! Sirene!! ...!?\n\nA powerful enemy, but she's breathed her last... Sirene, you were a terrifying enemy...
No, give her some credit, Akira. She was a magnificent enemy.
She's beautiful...
Bro! Take a look at that!
